message: The other day, as we were prepping for a storm, the grandkids were convinced our supplies looked like a party. "You mean we’re not having a snack party?" they asked, eyes wide with excitement over the bags of trail mix and bottled water. I tried to explain the importance of being ready, but all they could focus on was how we’d have a ‘camp-out’ in the living room. Sometimes, I think their enthusiasm is what keeps me calm. Who knew storm prep could be a family adventure? Just remember, a little bit of fun can go a long way when the weather gets a little wild! ☔️
